mapper.insert: insert into account( account_id, account_email, account_password, account_nickname, account_birth, account_contact, account_post, account_address1, account_address2, account_message ) values( #{accountId}, #{accountEmail}, #{accountPassword}, #{accountNickname}, #{accountBirth}, #{accountContact}, #{accountPost}, #{accountAddress1}, #{accountAddress2}, #{accountMessage} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from account where account_id = #{accountId}
select count(*) from account where account_nickname = #{accountNickname}
select count(*) from account where account_email = #{accountEmail}
mapper.update: update account set account_password =#{accountPassword}, account_change = systimestamp where account_id=#{accountId}

update account set account_nickname=#{accountNickname}, account_email=#{accountEmail}, account_birth=#{accountBirth}, account_contact=#{accountContact}, account_post=#{accountPost}, account_address1=#{accountAddress1}, account_address2=#{accountAddress2}, account_message=#{accountMessage}, where account_id=#{accountId}
